name: Higaki Eiko
source:
"Why do your classes always make me so sleepy? Hey, why do they?"

One day in the forest, she came across [url=/c113636]sensei[/url] who had fallen into XR.
She was the first person to kill him, and she can always be counted on to bring him back to reality.
Incidentally, the only way for the sensei to be returned to the real world is to be killed.
Even when he does not want to go back, she'll ask "hey, do you want to return?". It's a bit annoying.
Also, she is particular about the variation of her killings, and she gives a different performance every time.
In the case sensei has an accident or something that brings him back to reality, she'll exclaim "Isn't that a breach of contract? Infidelity?" which exposes a flaw in their relationship. In other words, she likes to bad mouth people, has a vicious habit of wanting to kill her sensei, and is even the jealous type on top of it all. But she is cute, so you can't hate her. The reason why she is so obsessed with killing sensei is a mystery.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]

Occupation: Assassin
